sloka: रावणस्य गृहे रुधा अस्माभिस्तु सुरक्षिता ।न त्वां शक्तः परित्रातुमपि साक्षात्पुरन्दरः ।। ५.२२.२६।।।।
transliteration: rāvaṇasya gṛhe rudhā asmābhistu surakṣitā ।na tvāṁ śaktaḥ paritrātumapi sākṣātpurandaraḥ ।। 5.22.26।।।।

translations.english: Wrapped well with a big black thread around his hips, he appeared like mount Mandara encompassed by a black serpent at the time of churning the milkocean for nectar.
